    THE LEADER’S ALMANAC

    You run the farm.

    Hank, Mara, Teo and June live here, and they do what you tell them. Every morning you decide who works where and who goes beyond the farm. Then you lead them through the day and keep them alive through the night.

    Operations.

    Each morning, after breakfast, the Operations board opens. Drag people onto a job (fields, construction, defense, scouting, clinic, rest) or onto an expedition, or click a person and then click where they go. Press O to open it again during the day.

    You decide when night falls.

    When the day’s timer runs out, the simulation freezes at sunset until you press Start the night (key N) next to the timer. You can also end a day early. Once the night’s zombies are all gone, time freezes until you greet the dawn. You can still plan orders while time is frozen.

    The horde comes every third night.

    Nights 1 and 2 are quiet: a few stragglers while you build up. Night 3 brings a horde of 30, and every third night after that a horde five bigger (35, 40, 45 …). Every second horde is a siege led by a Colossus. A night lasts until its zombies are gone, and the clock shows how many are left. Defenders hunt down any that reach the farmhouse out of sight.

    A small field.

    Farmers automatically plant wheat, corn or pumpkins according to your Crops upgrade level. There are no per-plot settings. The farm starts with 4 crop plots. Expand the field from the Build menu, or by clicking its empty ground: each expansion adds two plots, up to twelve, and a builder has to dig them.

    Everything is built by hand.

    Ordering a building or a defense only pays for it. A builder, or anyone you send, puts it up by daylight, with a progress bar. Two builders work twice as fast.

    Jobs and tools.

    Farmers fetch a scythe and defenders a shotgun from the warehouse (2 of each at first). Defenders shoot with your shared shells. Medics need a clinic.

    Keep the lights on.

    The small generator from your starting pack burns 1 gasoline a night. Without light, people panic outside in the dark. Scouts and expeditions bring back gasoline.

    New farms begin with four illustrated story scenes and practical survival guidance. Use the replay button below to watch them again. Back / Next and left / right arrows move through the story; Skip or Escape goes straight to the starting pack.

    Drag while placing fences to preview a whole line and its total cost. Open Farm life for construction priorities, survivor specializations and daily events. Operations can save day/night job routines and automatically switch them. The Saves screen has three slots, autosave recovery and export/import.

    Hover over anything to see what it is. Empty lots show the building that could stand there.
